title: Challenge (router to agent, text frame)
description: First message of every tunnel session, sent by the router right after the WebSocket upgrade. The agent signs the nonce in its hello. The agent waits at most 15 s for it.

nonce.description: Random bytes, standard base64 with padding. The router sends 32 bytes; the agent refuses fewer than 16.

router.description: Router version, informational. The Go agent ignores it.
